title: Targeted transduction of cells/tissue in vivo
protocol: Vortex In vivo ViroMag vial immediately before use.
Add suitable amount of In vivo ViroMag to a sterile microtube.
Do not exceed recommended volumes for injection.
Add virus preparation to the tube containing In vivo ViroMag reagent and mix by pipetting up & down.
Incubate complexes 15-30 min at room temperature.
Place magnet on targeted tissue before injection.
Slowly inject the complexes into the target tissue.
Let the magnet stand from 5 minutes to 1 hour after injection.
Monitor gene expression at appropriate time points.
